info.title: Analytic Madhyasth Darshan submission portal API
info.description: GitHub-authenticated API that backs the Web Submission Portal at https://analyticmadhyasthdarshan.org/Studies/submit.html. Contributors propose studies, submit drafts, update published markdown, and request Draft/Released status changes. Most write routes require a first-party session cookie plus a Cloudflare Turnstile token. Browser POST requests also require an exact trusted Origin and Content-Type: application/json, including logout. Local preview origins must be explicitly configured. All responses are private/no-store. The machine-only /api/notify endpoint uses its separate secret and JSON without browser cookies or Origin. JSON error responses use one envelope: success=false, code, message, requestId, and optional details. The same requestId is returned in the X-Request-ID response header.
